newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume jumps 68 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume jumps 68 pct in Jan.

text.p: Monthly volume on Istanbul's gold exchange surged to 21,649 kilos in January, up 68 percent from December 1996, mainly due to persistent free market demand fuelled by lower world prices during the month.
According to the Exchange's monthly bulletin, 61 percent of the January volume was recorded in lira terms and the rest in dollar terms, unchanged from December.
Daily average volume rose sharply to 984 kilos last month from 585 in December.
Total volume since the inauguration of the Exchange on July 26, 1995 has now reached 274,890 kilos. 1996 volume was 173,960 kilos.
